name: mig-recon-02-rebuild
description: After a migration or a latest_active_lot repair: rebuilds every published recon snapshot (settle, actual, traders; latest published settlement date per BU) that is older than a repair of latest_active_lot for its BU (latest_active_lot_reconcile_log). Same run id, pointer untouched, same advisory lock as the app refresh, so the app refresh and this rule cannot run together. Nothing stale means nothing is rebuilt, so a second run does nothing. No backup: derived rows, deleted and rebuilt by run id. CFS settle took 10 to 15 minutes on UAT, so a run over all BUs can take hours: run in a quiet window with the session settings statement_timeout=0, synchronous_commit=off, work_mem=256MB, maintenance_work_mem=1GB. Check first with mig-recon-01-check.xml; the verify reruns it. BUs with no published snapshot are listed by the check: refresh them in the app.

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.proname IN ('recon_materialize_settle','recon_materialize_actual','recon_materialize_traders','recon_postprocess_settle','recon_postprocess_actual','recon_postprocess_traders')
preconditions.reason: the recon builders and post-processors are deployed
